reviewer.actual_effort: Low effort setting. I read all of current.json, current-xml.xml, page-audits.json, english-rest-resolutions.json, english-routing-proof.xml and guideline-excerpts.md. I viewed the full original page images s187, s188, s189, s191 and s193 once each at the supplied display resolution (1208x2000 downscaled from 1368x2264). I compared every English word and punctuation mark in the 8 witnesses against those images. I made no enlarged crops because no English ambiguity needed one. I did not open the s182-189 or s190-197 overlap folders or the full report files, because the summarized audits plus my own page reading covered every English line in scope.

scope: English source accuracy and its JLPTEI encoding and guideline adherence, plus the shared Hebrew/English correspondence and page boundaries, for exactly: shofar_alah_elohim, shofar_psalm_47, shofar_blessing, shofar_shehecheyanu, shofar_ashrei_haam, torah_yequm_purqan_scholars, torah_yequm_purqan_congregation, torah_mi_sheberakh_kol_haqahal. Hebrew fine marks and Hebrew source acceptance are not assessed.
